title: Harcha (Moroccan Semolina Griddle Bread)
summary: Buttery semolina dough leavened with baking powder, shaped into discs and slowly griddled.
equipment: large heavy frying pan or griddle

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the semolina, sugar, baking powder and salt together, then rub in the melted butter until every grain is coated.

steps.title: Bind
steps.text: Add the milk and mix to a soft, wet dough; rest 10 min until it firms enough to shape.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Roll into 8 balls, flatten each to a 1 cm disc and press both sides into the coarse semolina.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook in the dry pan over medium-low heat 5-6 min each side until golden and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Warm, split and filled with butter and honey.

tips: Let the dough rest so the semolina absorbs the milk.
Cook low so the centre is done before the outside darkens.
storage: Keep wrapped at room temperature for 1 day; warm in a dry pan. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
